new_findings_not_in_R281.sensor_dropout_weakness: V2 is WORSE than B under sensor_dropout (0.80x ratio, V2 wins only 2/5 seeds). The rate limiter that makes V2 robust to noise makes it fragile to dropout — it can't recover fast enough when sensors return. This was NOT visible in the 1-seed R281 run. This is why multi-seed validation matters.
new_findings_not_in_R281.mechanism_interactions: R281 ablation (2 attacks) suggested only rate limiting mattered. R282 ablation (9 attacks) reveals hysteresis becomes critical under controller_delay, drainage floor becomes critical under sensor_dropout. The 4 mechanisms are NOT independent — they interact under different attack modes.
new_findings_not_in_R281.multi_failure_peak_reduced: R281 1-seed showed 224 mmHg peak under multi_failure. R282 5-seed shows 103.5 mmHg mean (lower, but still catastrophic). The 1-seed result was a worst-case seed.
